The four gun recipes on the Undercroft bench now cost exactly twice their old parts, and it shipped as v28.83 (cw-guncraft).

| Gun | Old cost | New cost |
|---|---|---|
| Compact SMG | 4 Component Kit, 3 Cracked Cell, 2 Circuit Board, 1 Servo Actuator | 8, 6, 4, 2 |
| Burst Carbine | 4 Component Kit, 2 Servo Actuator, 2 Circuit Board | 8, 4, 4 |
| Auto Rifle | 5 Component Kit, 2 Servo Actuator, 3 Circuit Board, 1 Optics Lens | 10, 4, 6, 2 |
| Riot Scattergun | 5 Component Kit, 4 Cracked Cell, 2 Circuit Board, 2 Servo Actuator | 10, 8, 4, 4 |

The new check failed on the old build and passed on the new one. It tests every gun recipe against double its old amount, and it also confirms the Medkit and Frag Charge recipes are unchanged. The gate passed and the seed 4242 fingerprint held (ents 85/374, containers 165/593). Itch and GitHub were pushed by the ship itself.

I did not run the older v11.79 gun-recipe check on its own. It requires gun parts to cost less than twice the shop price, and by my arithmetic the doubled recipes stay under that. That arithmetic uses the 2.4× shop-price fallback, not the real shop price.

TASK DONE
